headline: A ship carrying 51,000 metric tonnes of imported wheat, MV Gokova M, docked at Karachi port on Wednesday, with a second wheat vessel expected on November 3, according to the Karachi Port Trust.

card.desc: Second wheat ship expected at Karachi port on November 3.

caption:
